conditional_findings.classification: New current source finding: a parsed, validated graphics setting is not passed to the current grass cover raster consumer; no rendering or altered configuration was executed.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The retained grass cover feather setting has no demonstrated effect on the grass cover mask it names.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Grass transition configuration and grass_cover_mask_pixels distance-field radius.
conditional_findings.trace: GrassTransitionConfig declares cover_mask_feather_m and validate requires it positive; checked-in YAML supplies 4.8. grass_cover_mask_pixels receives only ground and seed and computes radius from hard-coded 4.8 metres. A literal tree search finds the setting only in configuration declaration/validation and YAML; it cannot rule out indirect behavior by itself. The current default coincides with the fixed value.
dependencies: Trace all configuration owners and decide whether feather is supported tuning or an obsolete field to remove under the clean-schema rule.
Keep the separate leaf-litter distance calculation and raster capacity issue distinct.
acceptance_requirements: The final configuration contract has one authoritative supported feather value or removes the inert field; ordinary 4.8-metre behavior remains intentional.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; direct producer/consumer disconnect and literal search recorded, policy and aliases open

conditional_findings.classification: New current source finding: declared tier compensation controls do not feed the selected grass material calculation.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Retained per-tier compensation values and limit are not used by the current width-compensation producer.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: GrassTierConfig and GrassMeshLod width compensation feeding TacticalGrassInstancedMaterial params.
conditional_findings.trace: GrassTierConfig declares width_compensation and width_compensation_limit; YAML supplies tier-specific values. GrassMeshLod::width_compensation takes only LOD and density, returns constants for Near, NearEdge and Vista, and clamps Far to hard-coded 1.65; diagnostics material passes that calculated value to params.w. Literal tree search finds field names in configuration/YAML but no direct field consumption. Shipped values match or closely match these constants, so divergence needs a non-default value.
dependencies: Resolve whether these are supported author controls or stale data left by renderer change; trace all current renderer/material aliases.
Keep source-level seed-head shader geometry issue and topology capacity independently connected.
acceptance_requirements: The supported tuning has one authoritative owner, or inert fields are removed, preserving intended tier transitions.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; source disconnect and default narrowing documented, intended configuration policy and aliases open

conditional_findings.classification: New current source question: validated root stratum data is retained but not read by the current placement/selection path.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The declared tier root-stratum setting is validated but has no direct consumer in current grass selection.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: GrassTierConfig root-stratum policy versus current tuft and fixed 32-root LOD selection.
conditional_findings.trace: root_stratum_side is an optional tier setting and validation requires a nonzero divisor of32; the YAML assigns Far4 and Vista8. The source-tree literal search finds no direct use beyond declaration, validation and YAML. The 32-root selector hard-codes Far4 and Vista8, while the only production blade_count call is for Far width compensation; grass_tuft_mesh uses its configured native blade side. Whether current root-stratum data is obsolete or intended to control an active representation is unresolved.
dependencies: Trace all grass selection and other renderer callers to determine the intended representation and exact alias with width compensation.
Do not preserve an obsolete compatibility field solely because historical source used it.
acceptance_requirements: One clear final schema and selection owner matches supported behavior, without maintaining a misleading unused control.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; direct-field use and fixed selector traced, policy and all callers open

conditional_findings.classification: New conditional current source question: the chunk culling bound does not explicitly include shader wind or player deformation; no culled scene or visual result observed.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Chunk bounds should conservatively cover supported animated grass vertices when CPU frustum culling uses them.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: InstanceReach and Cell::bounds for grass chunks, together with grass material/shader deformation.
conditional_findings.trace: Current grass batches pass horizontal reach equal to configured_tuft_footprint_metres, above1.5 and below0.3; Cell::bounds extends root positions by that reach and spawn marks NoAutoAabb. For the shipped Near tier the horizontal footprint is 1.81/12, about0.151m. The shader adds natural lean, wind and player interaction to visible blade curve positions; with the shipped minimum push0.7 and a stationary interactor within the fully weighted region, the interaction component alone is 0.62×0.7=0.434m along its push direction at a tip. It may be opposed or augmented by other terms, and actual blade/seed, chunk population and view are not established. The lock-matched Bevy camera source tests the entity AABB against the view frustum when CPU culling is enabled; the current queue only bins CPU-visible chunks.
conditional_findings.safeguards: Bounds are over all roots in each chunk, not a single root by default; padded distance bands, visibility, mesh shape, displacement cancellation and actual placement can prevent a visible error. Old6533 culling metadata included mesh/wind/push in a different GPU path, but that is historical and does not prove current behavior.
dependencies: Establish an admitted emitted vertex, deformation, chunk boundary and supported camera for which the whole chunk AABB is rejected while a deformed vertex should be visible.
Trace all other chunk-instanced materials and their distinct motion/bounds contracts without merging them by shared type.
acceptance_requirements: The chosen culling bound conservatively accounts for supported blade shape and deformation, or an explicit visibility policy justifies the omitted margin.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; source-level bound/deformation mismatch and native culling gate, reachability and impact open
